biotools.summary: Virtual Brain Inference (VBI) is an open-source toolkit for efficient Bayesian inference on whole-brain models, combining computational models of brain dynamics with individual brain imaging data. It provides fast simulations, data storage, and probabilistic machine learning algorithms for biophysically interpretable inference.
